features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: When you choose the Hexblade patron at 1st level, you gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. You can perform the somatic components of your warlock spells even when you have a weapon or shield in one or both hands.

features.name: Hexblade Expanded Spells
features.description: The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you when you reach the appropriate warlock level.

features.name: Hex Weapon
features.description: At 3rd level, your patron teaches you to channel your will through a chosen weapon. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one weapon that you are proficient with and that lacks the two-handed property. When you make an attack with that weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls. This benefit lasts until you finish your next long rest. If you later gain the Pact of the Blade feature, this benefit applies to any pact weapon you conjure, regardless of the weapon's properties.

features.name: Thirsting Blade
features.description: At 7th level, you gain the Thirsting Blade Eldritch Invocation, ignoring its prerequisites. If you already know Thirsting Blade, you can instead choose another Eldritch Invocation for which you qualify.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: At 11th level, your curses twist fate against your enemies. When a creature affected by one of your warlock spells hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to roll a d6. On a roll of 4 or higher, the attack misses you instead, regardless of the attack roll.

features.name: Far Wanderer
features.description: At 17th level, prolonged exposure to your patron's otherworldly influence has fundamentally changed you. You no longer need to breathe, and you gain resistance to fire and cold damage.
